questions.q: What is the primary purpose of the recruiter / phone screen stage?
options: To test deep Kubernetes and Terraform knowledge
To check basic fit, logistics, and your overall story, before investing engineer time
To assign a final offer
To run a take-home exercise
questions.explain: The recruiter screen filters for fit, logistics, and a basic sense of your background before the company invests engineer time in deeper technical stages.

questions.q: What is the system design / whiteboarding stage actually evaluating?
options: Memorized trivia about specific tool flags
Typing speed
Reasoning under ambiguity and awareness of trade-offs
Whether you can draw neatly
questions.explain: System design interviews test how a candidate reasons through ambiguous requirements and weighs trade-offs, not memorized facts.

questions.q: Why is it useful to reference the capstone's real autoscaling trade-off (checkout vs. product-catalog) in a system design interview?
options: It fills time without adding value
It lets you reason from a real design instead of inventing one cold
It proves you memorized the HPA settings exactly
System design interviews never involve scaling
questions.explain: Referencing a real trade-off you reasoned through gives a concrete anchor to extend to a new problem, rather than guessing from scratch.

questions.q: What does the technical screen stage primarily verify?
options: Whether you can pass a personality test
Whether you actually did the work your resume claims, through real depth of knowledge
Your available start date
Your preferred PTO policy
questions.explain: The technical screen checks for real depth in areas like Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and Terraform to confirm the resume's claims hold up under questioning.

questions.q: For a take-home exercise, what should a candidate prioritize?
options: An incomplete but highly advanced solution
A working solution with clear documentation, even if simpler
Submitting as fast as possible with no explanation
Avoiding any README to keep the code private
questions.explain: A working, documented solution is valued far more than an incomplete attempt at something more advanced — the same principle the capstone's own portfolio guidance applies.
